status: exact first-order corrected-main target reconciliation, box-optimal contact reduction, and low-c Abel handoff
proof_boundary: This artifact reconciles the zeroth- and first-order targets, proves the cutoff-local Cartesian and phase/amplitude energy identities, derives the first-order contact box, radial sufficient threshold, box-optimal signed criterion, and exact Abel-to-band implication, and restricts the outer arithmetic target to the oscillatory-spliced low-c wedge. It does not prove the Xi Abel gap, a one-turn phase budget, the q<1 or bounded-L inner theorem, contact exclusion, Q209, the cofinal descendant theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or a Clay-prize conclusion.

source_audit.zeroth_order_target: Prove T_L[J]>32000000*exp(-3L/2) for the corrected finite main
source_audit.first_order_remainder: For every critical disk, including cutoff crossings, |r_[1](x)|<100000*exp(-5L/4) and |partial_x r_[1](x)|<200000*L*exp(-5L/4)
source_audit.cofinal_cutoff_coverage: The first-order remainder theorem covers every critical disk, including adjacent-cutoff crossings.
source_audit.inherited_boundary: The first-order theorem supersedes the older remainder scale. It does not prove the signed main-jet separation.

source_reconciliation.supersession: The first-order corrected main and exp(-5L/4) C1 remainder supersede the older exp(-3L/4) handoff on L>=50, 0<tL<25.

local_lift.rule: On each critical radius-1/L disk choose one prescribed-N analytic lift E_[1],N; at a cutoff, the adjacent-lift difference is retained in r_[1].
local_lift.pointwise_quantifier: At each point, one certified local lift with its matched remainder is enough for pointwise contact exclusion.
local_lift.degree_quantifier: Boundary-degree composition must include equality boundaries and every prescribed adjacent chart/homotopy.

phase_amplitude.sum: T_L[J_[1]]/4=[sum_j a_j cos(theta_j)]^2+L^-2[sum_j a_j{u_j cos(theta_j)-v_j sin(theta_j)}]^2
phase_amplitude.zero_component_guard: The Cartesian c_j,d_j formula is primary when an endpoint component vanishes; no phase or rate quotient is taken.

cross_term_expansion.rank: The component Gram form has rank at most two, independent of the number of components.
cross_term_expansion.boundary: This is an algebraic nonpromotion guard, not an actual Xi configuration.

direct_radial_target.meaning: The first-order target is exponentially smaller and hence strictly easier as a lower-bound obligation.

box_optimal_target.minimality: This excludes exactly the certified axis-aligned contact box; it does not replace it by a larger ellipse.
box_optimal_target.radial_overstrength: In normalized units delta=1, gamma=2, (X,U)=(0,21/10) has G=21/20>1 but X^2+U^2=441/100<5=delta^2+gamma^2.

abel_target.composition: The Abel target gives |mathsf_A|>A_L, hence |A_a|>(100000L+1)exp(-5L/4); the real-residual bound then gives |U|>100000L exp(-5L/4).
abel_target.conclusion: The division-free Abel gap implies the box-optimal signed band and therefore excludes a first-order contact.

outer_domain_reduction.closed_middle: c_*+epsilon<tL<=25 is closed by the oscillatory-zeta theorem beyond L_epsilon.
outer_domain_reduction.closed_dominant: tL>=25 is closed by the dominant-saddle theorem.
outer_domain_reduction.inner_open: q<1, the bounded-L shoulder, finite joins, and the multiplicity-compatible inner degree theorem remain separate.

nonpromotion.diagonal: Positive diagonal component energies do not lower-bound the two-dimensional sum because the cross terms can cancel them exactly.
nonpromotion.ordered_phase: Positive component amplitudes and ordered phase speeds do not exclude a double real crossing; the checked four-component countermodel already realizes one.
nonpromotion.finite: A finite phase plot or sampled minimum cannot prove the uniform low-c, cutoff-complete Abel gap.

exact.route_decision: Retire the old exp(-3L/2) target and do not attack the stronger radial first-order target by diagonal positivity. The exact main-only obligation is rectangle avoidance; the current proof-facing sufficient theorem is its robust division-free Abel form. Restrict that arithmetic work to the oscillatory-spliced low-c q>=1 wedge, and keep q<1/bounded-L degree closure as a separate theorem.
exact.open_handoff: On one fixed epsilon collar, derive a source-specific lower bound for the endpoint-complete Abel scalar mathcal_C_N in the band |mathsf_X|<=delta_L for L>=B_epsilon, q>=1, and 0<tL<=c_*+epsilon. Preserve W_0=0, the recurrent endpoint, q=1, equality boundaries, and adjacent-cutoff homotopies. Start from the exact prefix sum U=u_N*S+sum_k log((k+1)/k)F_k and test signed cancellation before absolute values.

rows.proof_boundary: The endpoint component g_0 is retained.

rows.claim: The first-order C1 remainder is globally controlled across cutoff crossings.
rows.proof_boundary: Valid on L>=50 and 0<tL<25.

rows.claim: The corrected main is a cutoff-local analytic lift with its chart difference retained in the remainder.

rows.claim: Pointwise exclusion and boundary-degree composition have different chart quantifiers.
rows.formula: At each point, one certified local lift with its matched remainder is enough for pointwise contact exclusion. Boundary-degree composition must include equality boundaries and every prescribed adjacent chart/homotopy.
rows.proof_boundary: No global complex-main chart invariance is asserted.

rows.claim: The first-order main jet has a division-free Cartesian energy.
rows.proof_boundary: z_0=g_0; z_n=f_n for 1<=n<=N; c_j=Re(z_j), d_j=Re(z_(j,x))

rows.claim: Every nonzero component has an exact phase/amplitude contribution to the two real jet coordinates.
rows.proof_boundary: The Cartesian c_j,d_j formula is primary when an endpoint component vanishes; no phase or rate quotient is taken.

rows.claim: The full phase energy is the square of two linked signed component sums.
rows.formula: T_L[J_[1]]/4=[sum_j a_j cos(theta_j)]^2+L^-2[sum_j a_j{u_j cos(theta_j)-v_j sin(theta_j)}]^2
rows.proof_boundary: All endpoint and first-correction components remain in the sums.

rows.claim: The phase energy expands into diagonal masses plus signed cross terms.
rows.proof_boundary: w_j=(c_j,d_j/L) in R^2

rows.claim: Componentwise positive energy cannot provide the required aggregate lower bound.
rows.proof_boundary: This is an algebraic nonpromotion guard, not an actual Xi configuration.

rows.claim: One radial first-order energy floor is sufficient for contact exclusion.

rows.claim: The contact rectangle has an exact anisotropic maximum-norm gauge.
rows.proof_boundary: This excludes exactly the certified axis-aligned contact box; it does not replace it by a larger ellipse.

rows.claim: Rectangle avoidance is exactly the signed first-order band target.
rows.proof_boundary: This is weaker than the radial sufficient target.

rows.claim: The radial target strictly overcovers the certified contact rectangle.
rows.formula: In normalized units delta=1, gamma=2, (X,U)=(0,21/10) has G=21/20>1 but X^2+U^2=441/100<5=delta^2+gamma^2.

rows.proof_boundary: The division-free Abel gap implies the box-optimal signed band and therefore excludes a first-order contact.
